def: A loop in which a candidate's output includes changes to code, prompts or settings that run in the next iteration.
The files and settings an agent is permitted to edit, as opposed to the trusted core it must not touch.
The evaluator, selection rule, limits, lineage writer and guard, kept outside the loop's reach.
Code that checks a proposed change against a policy on paths, patterns and size before it is allowed to run.
The record of every candidate with its parent, diff, scores, logs and approver, used for audit and rollback.
A log in which each record includes the hash of the previous one, so altering history becomes detectable.
A cap on CPU time, wall-clock time, memory, disk or processes that a sandbox enforces on running code.
A point in the loop where a person must approve a change or promotion before it proceeds.
